adaptations: Actual supplied DLL's BuildAutoBattleUnit, StrategicBattleRules.BuildUnit, MagicManager.LoadConfig XML parsing, skill lookup and Simulate bytecode run. Only Unity Resources.Load and TextAsset.text are replaced by a null resource handle and the extracted original MagicConfig XML. No Android scene or native renderer is claimed.
For actual automatic duel writeback tests, Unity integer Random returns its lower bound; otherwise the actual ResolveAutoDuel/ApplyAutoBattleSimulation/WarResult and Misc experience bytecode run.

Whole-battle tests retain OnAutoAllConfirmed, OnReturnMain, RefreshAfterAutoSingle, OnRightGeneralSelected, OnSubMenu and draw dialogue state. Rendering setters and dialogue drawing are no-ops; button enablement is stored on a test-only Button field. OnWarOver is an observation counter. Confirmation SetActive/LogError are no-ops; Unity null equality uses reference equality. No Android touch dispatch is simulated.
